import os
p='/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-low-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference/play/users/u054/system/state/workspace/programs/task-8366081f.py'
code='''def transform(grid):
    # Arrange the colored objects in left-to-right order, stepping down-right
    # so each successive object meets the preceding one.
    import collections
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    seen=set(); objs=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            col=grid[r][c]
            if col and (r,c) not in seen:
                q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
                while q:
                    y,x=q.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        z=(y+dy,x+dx)
                        if 0<=z[0]<H and 0<=z[1]<W and z not in seen and grid[z[0]][z[1]]==col:
                            seen.add(z); q.append(z)
                minr=min(y for y,x in cells); maxr=max(y for y,x in cells); minc=min(x for y,x in cells); maxc=max(x for y,x in cells)
                objs.append((minc,col,[(y-minr,x-minc) for y,x in cells],maxr-minr+1,maxc-minc+1))
    objs.sort()
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    r=c=0
    for i,(_,col,cells,h,w) in enumerate(objs):
        for y,x in cells:
            if r+y<H and c+x<W: out[r+y][c+x]=col
        if i<len(objs)-1:
            # advance to the next diagonal contact position
            r += h-1 if h>1 else 1
            c += w-1 if w>1 else 1
    return out
'''
